checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Headline reads exactly 'SLOW SUNDAY' with no other words
must.why: Two lines, spelled correctly, no extra words.

must.item: Headline about 1.5x original size and fully inside canvas
must.why: Text width is about 84% of canvas in both images; it is essentially unchanged in size.

must.item: Headline keeps original font, dark brown colour and centre point
must.why: Same font, colour and position, because nothing really changed.

must.item: Cup illustration and cream background unchanged
must.why: Cup and background look the same, with minor re-rendering and slightly different dimensions.
Both images are tall 9:16 portrait, not square.

faults.what: The text was not enlarged by about 1.5x. It is virtually identical in size to the first poster, so the main request failed.
The canvas is slightly different in size (352x640 vs 360x640), and the cup is slightly re-rendered.
The poster is portrait 9:16, not square as the must-have specifies.

summary: The edit returned a poster with correct text and a preserved cup, but the headline is not visibly larger, so the requested 1.5x enlargement did not happen.
